g.text: Task intervals are clipped unions; overlap is counted once. LLM client time includes queue/network.
Stages exclude queue/network and are NOT GPU-exclusive time. Uncached input may include recomputation. Missing telemetry is not zero.
Running requests are not measured decode sequences. Replica means require full-window samples; KV fractions are never summed.
